name: dns_lookup
description: Look up DNS records for a domain or hostname: A (IPv4), AAAA (IPv6), MX (mail servers), CNAME, NS (nameservers), TXT, or reverse DNS (IP to hostname).

record_type.description: Which DNS record type to look up. 'reverse' takes an IP address and returns its hostname; all others take a domain/hostname.

hostname.description: The domain or hostname to look up. Required for A, AAAA, MX, CNAME, NS, TXT.

ip_address.description: The IP address to reverse-lookup. Required for record_type='reverse'.
